fixes: Turn on the RevenueCat → Mixpanel integration. Trials, conversions, renewals and refunds land on the same person, which unlocks trial → paid and real MRR.
Tag App Store links on the site with campaign tokens (?pt=…&ct=home_hero, ct=start_done and so on). App Store Connect then shows installs per placement, which closes the site → install gap.

Give every social link its own tag. Point the Instagram and YouTube bio links to wisdomquotes.in/?utm_source=instagram (or youtube), and send any direct App Store link with ct=ig_bio / ct=yt_bio. Zernio reports 0 profile views and 0 website clicks for every reel, so check the Instagram account's insights permission in Zernio as well.
Filter sandbox purchases. Add environment (sandbox/production) to Purchase Completed and exclude $ae_iap from reports. Today's 47 v3 events are all tests.
Add country as a super property in the app so every funnel can be split into ICP vs India from day one of v3.
Name the web /start events to match the app (Verse Revealed, Week Started) so the web 7-day plan and the app plan show up in one Mixpanel funnel.

social.postsNote: The 55-second story reel ("not made for you") still has 2.5× the likes of any other post and the longest watch time. The 131-second follow-up from 29 Oct has settled at a 78% skip rate and 3.3s average watch on 124 views, the same as the short quote cards. Story length alone did not hold people; the first 3 seconds decide it.

web.weeklyClicksNote: CTR holds at about 2.3%, so growth comes from impressions. The jump since 24 Oct lines up with the SEO fixes from 25 Oct; 30 Oct dipped to 36 clicks, which may be partial data.
web.weeklyVisitorsNote: The 28 Sep spike (863) was a one-off. Underneath it, visitors were flat at about 300 a week until the last week, when daily visitors rose to 80 to 90.
web.startNote: Only a third of people who answer a question get to see verses. That is the leak to fix first: the verse should appear before they are asked anything else. The first web /start completion showed up this week (1 of 31).
web.splitNote: Your ICP is the diaspora (US, UK, CA, AU), but they are only 1 in 4 visitors. Over 28 days US CTR is 1.65% against 2.37% for India, at a similar position (7.3 vs 6.8). In the last 7 days US CTR rose to 2.6%, an early sign the new titles help.
web.topPagesNote: The top page is the Hindi Gita page, which pulls Indian, Hindi-reading visitors (not the ICP). The English blogs with 1.3 to 1.5% CTR are where better titles pay off for the diaspora.

app.retentionNote: Benchmark for a daily-habit app: D1 at least 30%, D7 at least 15%. v3's whole bet is the Day-2 verse reveal, so put a Mixpanel retention report on Verse Revealed (home), cohorted by first_open_date, on the day you launch.
